readme:
# TheFork Restaurant Scraper

Get restaurants from TheFork city lists as clean rows. For each restaurant you get the name, link, cuisines, address, coordinates, TheFork rating and review count, average price, current offers, booking times, awards, tags and photos. No login and no account needed.

Use it to build restaurant lists for a city, compare prices and ratings between districts, follow offers over time, or find places with free tables.

## What you get

One row per restaurant, in the order of the list. Main fields:

- Identity: `id`, `uuid`, `url`, `name`, `slug`
- Food: `cuisine`, `cuisines`, `dish_types`, `dietary_options`, `ambiance`, `services`, `languages`
- Place: `address`, `formatted_address`, `city`, `postal_code`, `country`, `neighborhoods`, `latitude`, `longitude`
- Price: `average_price`, `currency`, `price_level`, `price_range`
- Rating: `rating` (TheFork score), `rating_scale`, `review_count`
- Offers: `has_offer`, `best_discount_percent`, `promotions`
- Booking: `is_bookable`, `has_availability`, `accepts_reservations`, `reservations_today`, `timeslots`
- Distinctions: `awards`, `top_chart_rank`, `top_chart_size`, `has_loyalty_program`
- Media and tags: `main_photo_url`, `photos`, `tags`, `payment_methods`
- Context: `position`, `page`, `source_url`, `data_source`, `scraped_at`

Fields the page does not show are empty (`null` or an empty list).

## Input

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `startUrls` | list of URLs | TheFork city pages, for example `https://www.thefork.com/restaurants/paris-c415144`. Local sites such as thefork.fr, thefork.it and thefork.es work too. |
| `maxResults` | number | Most restaurants to return for each address. Default 50. Each page holds 25. |
| Connection settings | form field | Leave the default. The actor picks the connection it needs. |

Example:

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.thefork.com/restaurants/paris-c415144",
    "https://www.thefork.com/restaurants/milan-c348156"
  ],
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

You can also start from a later page by adding `?p=3` to the address.

The full row also holds `promotions`, `awards`, `tags`, `photos` and the other fields listed above.

## Pricing

You pay per result, plus a small start fee per run.

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 |
| Restaurant scraped (`thefork-restaurant-result`) | $2.00 per 1,000 |

A run is charged for the restaurants it delivers. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops when it is reached and says so in the run status.

## Limitations

- The actor reads the city and area list pages. It does not open each restaurant page, so menus, opening hours, phone numbers and full review texts are not included.
- Booking times, offers and the number of reservations made today are a snapshot of the moment the page was read. They change during the day.
- The rating is the TheFork score on a scale of 10. Other review sites are not included.
- Lists are limited to what the site shows. Very long lists may stop before the last page, and the page numbers the site serves can change.
- The site can answer slowly or refuse a request. The actor retries, and a run that cannot read any page ends with an error and no charge.
- Names, tags and labels come in the language of the site you start from. Use a local site address to get local labels.
- Only the first start address page that matches the city id is read. A wrong city name in the address can show another city.

## FAQ

**Can I scrape a whole city?**
Set `maxResults` high. A page holds 25 restaurants and the actor reads one page after another until it has enough or the list ends.

**Which addresses work?**
City and area list pages on thefork.com and on local sites such as thefork.fr, thefork.it and thefork.es that use the same page layout.

**Why do I get fewer rows than I asked for?**
The list may be shorter than `maxResults`, or a run may have reached the maximum cost you set. The run status says which.

**Are rows repeated across pages?**
No. Each restaurant is returned once per run.

**What happens if a run is interrupted?**
The actor saves its progress and continues where it stopped, without returning rows twice or charging them twice.

**Do I need a TheFork account?**
No. The actor reads public list pages only, and it skips addresses that the site asks automated tools not to read.
